task: Map how the DAY policy computes whole-day counts: trace every call path from engine.py into periods.py that converts an instant to a day count, list each rounding-up site with file and line, and report how partial days at period start vs period end are treated. Read-only; produce a findings note in the repo's docs area.
done_when: A findings note lists every day-count call site (file:line) from engine entry to periods helper, and states the current partial-day behaviour at both period edges with the code that decides it.

task: Inventory the error surface: for each exception in errors.py (including StaleSubscriptionError and CadenceChangeError), find every raise site in the library, the exact condition that triggers it, and whether tests/ covers that raise. Report gaps without adding tests.
done_when: A table maps each exception class to its raise sites (file:line), trigger condition, and the covering test id or 'uncovered'.

task: Write an ADR plus a slice plan for adding a MINUTE proration policy alongside SECOND/DAY/NONE: define where the policy enum and dispatch live, the contract for the new granularity helper, and how it rounds partial minutes; break the work into 3-4 test-backed slices with the failing test named for each.
done_when: An ADR file is committed recording the decision and rejected alternatives, and the plan lists ordered slices each naming its first failing test and the public signatures it touches.

task: Plan the extraction of proration-policy dispatch out of engine.py into a small policy module: define the shared policy interface (inputs, return type, error contract), state that public behaviour and exception types are unchanged, and sequence the refactor so tests stay green at each step.
done_when: A plan document names the new module, gives the policy interface signature, and lists the ordered steps with the test suite passing after each one.

task: Add Money.split_evenly(n) built on the existing largest-remainder allocate: split a total into n equal parts whose remainders land on the earliest parts, rejecting n <= 0. TDD it in tests/test_money.py, covering negative totals, n larger than the minor-unit total, and JPY (0-decimal) and KWD (3-decimal) currencies.
done_when: New tests in tests/test_money.py fail before the implementation and pass after, parts always sum exactly to the original total, and the full suite is green.

task: Fix the reported seat-count-decrease bug where a second change inside the same period credits more than was actually charged: write the failing regression test in tests/test_engine.py that reproduces it (upgrade, then a seat decrease later in the same period), then correct the credit basis so credit never exceeds what was charged.
done_when: The regression test fails on the current code, passes after the fix, and no existing engine or plans test changes behaviour.

task: Implement the month-end anchor drift tests requested by review: add table-driven cases in tests/test_periods.py for anchors on the 29th, 30th and 31st crossing February in both a leap and a non-leap year, covering at least 14 consecutive periods each, and fix any drift the tests expose.
done_when: tests/test_periods.py covers all three anchors across leap and non-leap Februaries for 14+ periods, every boundary matches the original anchor day whenever the month allows, and the suite passes.

task: Review the seat-decrease credit fix branch against its acceptance criteria: check the credit-vs-charged invariant holds for three or more changes in one period, look for sign errors on downgrades, off-by-one at the half-open period boundary, and any new float or division-truncation path. Report findings only.
done_when: A review report lists each finding with file:line, severity, and a concrete failing input, or states explicitly that the invariant holds under the cases checked.

task: Audit Money for rounding and overflow correctness independent of the current tests: verify half-up-away-from-zero on negatives, allocate with zero weights, all-zero weight vectors, and a total smaller than the number of parts; confirm no code path produces a float. Report findings; do not fix.
done_when: A findings list covers each case with the exact inputs tried and observed vs expected output, and names any code path where a float or a rounding asymmetry appears.

task: Run the MINUTE-policy feature from request to done: take the architect's ADR and slices, delegate each slice to the implementer, gate each on the reviewer, and thread the results into a single summary including README updates to the policy list and any decisions taken at gates.
done_when: All planned slices are merged with the suite green, each slice has a recorded reviewer verdict, and the README policy list plus a one-page summary of gate decisions are updated.
